description: Install an already-built APK for a module + variant onto the resolved target. Does not rebuild - run build_device first if sources changed. Pass apkPath directly to skip variant lookup entirely.

apkPath.description: Explicit path to a .apk, bypassing module/variant lookup.

reinstall.description: Pass -r to adb install to keep existing app data. Default true.

title: Install App
